scope: offline STEP, manual XYZAC G-code and Rotary selection compatibility comparison

step.provenance: user-provided example; STEP header names Haoge_aimoyu and SolidWorks 2026; redistribution rights not independently confirmed

gcode.provenance: user-provided manual/reference code; generator and redistribution rights not independently confirmed

gcode_truth.parser: independent streaming modal parser; does not import five_axis_slicer parser or Rotary implementation

rotary_motion.large_positive_extrusion_move_interpreta: 30.60 to 39.42 degree C changes coincide with 32 mm-class Y/Z moves and E 1.67 to 1.95; they may be intentional radial deposition strokes but require coordinated-axis interpolation, collision and readback evidence before qualification

alignment_hypothesis.step_registration: rotate STEP 180 degrees about global Z at X=Y=0
alignment_hypothesis.interpretation: strong global frame/zero-angle registration candidate; not an exact point-to-BRep surface error measurement

rotary_selection_test.method: production RotaryPage and bind_rotary_geometry_references with injected SelectionState-compatible selection; not a Computer Use mouse click

production_vtk_state_test.render_blocker: vtkWin32OpenGLRenderWindow had no valid pixel format / GL version and the native render process faulted

rotary_selection_test.semantic_limit: selected faces derive axis, radius and axial profile; they do not automatically derive a trimmed angular region. For the two half-cylinder hub faces, select both for a full-surface reference and set operation angles/regions explicitly.

verdict.geometric_error: not demonstrated; the 180-degree mismatch is consistent with an unregistered global frame/zero-angle convention, while only envelope alignment has been measured
verdict.process_strategy_difference: demonstrated; the manual file mixes XYZ support/base with three fixed-A, varying-C multi-axis blade programs and is not one fixed-axis Rotary operation
verdict.support_scope: whole fan is outside current Rotary surface contract; the hub cylinder is a valid local Rotary candidate; blade faces belong to Freeform/Curve-class planning
verdict.product_gap: surface selection does not infer trimmed angular coverage, so treating one half-cylinder face as an automatic 180-degree region would be incorrect
verdict.qualification_gap: controller axis semantics, real rotary centre, tool length, IK/FK, axis limits and dynamics, collision, generated-toolpath readback and physical trial remain unverified

validation.computer_use: unavailable after documented retries; no apps enumerated and browser bridge returned nodeRepl.fetch request failed
validation.production_vtk_render: unavailable in this executor because no valid OpenGL pixel format was exposed
